summary: Independently read the complete 21-page paper in its markdown conversion, through the final citation; no appendix or supplement is included or identified. Checked all six estimates against their cited PDF pages using pymupdf text extraction, and recovered Table 5 with find_tables. All recorded arm means, SDs, t statistics, F statistics, degrees of freedom, p values, Cohen d values and partial eta-squared values match the correct outcomes and ChatGPT-versus-control contrast on PDF pp. 11-12 (printed pp. 49-50). The analyzed sample size of 124 is printed on PDF p. 7 (printed p. 45); the paper reports no outcome-specific exclusions. Per-arm counts correctly remain null under extraction rule 1 because their explicit totals appear only in Figure 1; demographic cells were not summed. Procedure on PDF p. 4 (printed p. 42) explicitly reports individual random assignment and both arms within classroom sessions. PDF pp. 5 and 8-10 (printed pp. 43 and 46-48) support the recorded arms, scoring, participant units, immediate with-AI outcomes, constructs, category_count measures, directions, between-person comparison and participant-based uncertainty. ANCOVA adjusts for prior ChatGPT experience, not a post-treatment outcome. The three unadjusted records and three ANCOVA records are alternative analyses of the same three outcomes in one sample. All eligible outcomes and contrasts are present. Baseline creativity, self-reports, metacognitive calibration, within-arm correlations, nonrandomized covariate effects and experiment duration are appropriately excluded. No verification problems found.
